session_and_repeat_interpretation.receipt_scope_limit: The later retained NEXT_ROUND receipt belongs to session 1 / COMPOSE presentation 0. It is not a fresh authority action in session 3 / native presentation 4.
session_and_repeat_interpretation.diagnostic_scope_limit: Session continuity, native close/dormancy, retained engine identities and fresh local input are observations/test-source claims, not pixel facts. The two last PNG identities share complete bytes and the same cached observationSequence 1327; separate filenames and titles do not establish a separate input.

gaps: The first selected-hand PNG is taken inside revealSelectHide before Hide. Source lines 51–57 reveal and select again before Play. Assigned image 1 is not an immediate pre-Play photograph.
The second and third native entries have no dedicated native screenshots in this capture flow; their later Standard/Leave captures cannot substitute for native entry pixels.
capture() creates a screenshot, then attaches cached lastDocument. Pair attachment timestamps differ by 0–3 ms, but this is not simultaneous observation sampling or an input-timing measurement.
